from typing import List

class Solution:
    def minimumSum(self, nums: List[int]) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        INF = float('inf')
        ans = INF
        for i in range(n - 2):
            for j in range(i + 1, n - 1):
                if nums[i] >= nums[j]:
                    continue
                for k in range(j + 1, n):
                    if nums[k] < nums[j]:
                        s = nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k]
                        if s < ans:
                            ans = s
        return -1 if ans == INF else ans
